activate.summary: One concept, one quiz, one card and one drill.
activate.insight: The database decides, not the browser.

concepts.name: Row Level Security
concepts.definition: Postgres policies that filter which rows each user can read or write.

section.title: RLS: security lives in the database
section.markdown:
## What it is

A policy per table, evaluated on every query.

## Say it in the call

Every table has RLS enabled.

quizzes.question: What bypasses RLS in Supabase?
quizzes.explanation: The service role key skips RLS, so it only lives on the server.

open.question: Explain RLS in two sentences.
open.expected_answer: Policies in Postgres decide which rows a user can see; a direct API call gets nothing it should not.

cards.back: The service role key. Server only.

drills.title: Sample drill
drills.text_en: Every table has RLS enabled. Even a direct API call returns nothing it should not.
drills.text_es: Cada tabla tiene RLS activado. Incluso una llamada directa a la API no devuelve nada que no deba.
